model.demo_analytics.stg_customers.name: stg_customers
model.demo_analytics.stg_customers.description: Staging model for customer data with basic cleaning and standardization
model.demo_analytics.stg_customers.raw_sql:
WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        email,
        phone,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        account_status,
        customer_segment
    FROM {{ source('ecommerce', 'raw_customers') }}
    WHERE updated_at >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE)
),

cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        TRIM(UPPER(first_name)) AS first_name,
        TRIM(UPPER(last_name)) AS last_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS email,
        phone,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN account_status = 'active' THEN 'ACTIVE'
            WHEN account_status = 'inactive' THEN 'INACTIVE'
            WHEN account_status = 'suspended' THEN 'SUSPENDED'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
        END AS account_status,
        customer_segment,
        CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS full_name,
        DATEDIFF(day, created_at, CURRENT_DATE) AS days_since_signup
    FROM source_data
)

SELECT * FROM cleaned

),

model.demo_analytics.fct_customer_orders.name: fct_customer_orders
model.demo_analytics.fct_customer_orders.description: Fact table combining customer and order information with aggregated metrics for analytics
model.demo_analytics.fct_customer_orders.raw_sql:
WITH customers AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('stg_customers') }}
),

orders AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
),

order_items AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('stg_order_items') }}
),

customer_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(o.total_amount) AS lifetime_value,
        AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value,
        MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date,
        MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date,
        DATEDIFF(day, MIN(o.order_date), MAX(o.order_date)) AS customer_lifetime_days
    FROM orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),

order_details AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.full_name,
        c.email,
        c.customer_segment,
        c.account_status,
        o.order_date,
        o.order_status,
        o.total_amount,
        o.discount_amount,
        o.tax_amount,
        o.shipping_amount,
        o.payment_method,
        ca.total_orders,
        ca.lifetime_value,
        ca.avg_order_value,
        ca.last_order_date,
        ca.first_order_date,
        ca.customer_lifetime_days,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date) AS customer_order_number,
        CASE
            WHEN ca.total_orders = 1 THEN 'First Time'
            WHEN ca.total_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'Regular'
            WHEN ca.total_orders > 5 THEN 'VIP'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS customer_tier
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN customer_aggregates ca ON o.customer_id = ca.customer_id
)

SELECT * FROM order_details
